title: acmispon tomentosus
intro: Acmispon tomentosus, commonly known as Antelope Bitterbrush, is a shrub native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in the traditional use of Native American communities. Acmispon tomentosus is known to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
